### Enhanced Layer (Modern CSS + Basic JavaScript)
```css
/* Progressive Enhancement CSS */
.analytics-dashboard {
  /* Base styles for all browsers */
  display: block;
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* Modern browsers with CSS Grid support */
@supports (display: grid) {
  .analytics-dashboard {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;
    gap: 2rem;
  }
  
  .dashboard-cards {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
    gap: 1.5rem;
  }
}

/* Flexbox fallback for older browsers */
@supports not (display: grid) {
  .analytics-dashboard {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  
  .dashboard-cards {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 1.5rem;
  }
}

/* Advanced features for capable browsers */
@supports (backdrop-filter: blur(10px)) {
  .dashboard-card {
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
  }
}
```

### Advanced Layer (Modern APIs + Optimizations)
```typescript
// Feature Detection and Progressive Enhancement
class ProgressiveEnhancement {
  constructor() {
    this.capabilities = this.detectCapabilities();
    this.initializeFeatures();
  }

  private detectCapabilities() {
    return {
      // Modern JavaScript APIs
      intersectionObserver: 'IntersectionObserver' in window,
      resizeObserver: 'ResizeObserver' in window,
      speechRecognition: 'webkitSpeechRecognition' in window || 'SpeechRecognition' in window,
      
      // Web APIs
      serviceWorker: 'serviceWorker' in navigator,
      webSocket: 'WebSocket' in window,
      localStorageAvailable: this.testLocalStorage(),
      
      // CSS Features
      cssGrid: CSS.supports('display', 'grid'),
      cssCustomProperties: CSS.supports('color', 'var(--test)'),
      backdropFilter: CSS.supports('backdrop-filter', 'blur(10px)'),
      
      // Device Capabilities
      touchEvents: 'ontouchstart' in window,
      pointerEvents: 'PointerEvent' in window,
      deviceMotion: 'DeviceMotionEvent' in window
    };
  }

  private initializeFeatures() {
    // Enhanced Chart Rendering
    if (this.capabilities.intersectionObserver) {
      this.initializeLazyChartLoading();
    }
    
    // Real-time Data Updates
    if (this.capabilities.webSocket) {
      this.initializeRealTimeUpdates();
    } else {
      this.initializePollingFallback();
    }
    
    // Natural Language Query
    if (this.capabilities.speechRecognition) {
      this.initializeSpeechInput();
    }
    
    // Offline Capability
    if (this.capabilities.serviceWorker) {
      this.registerServiceWorker();
    }
  }

  private testLocalStorage(): boolean {
    try {
      const test = 'test';
      localStorage.setItem(test, test);
      localStorage.removeItem(test);
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }
}
```

## Implementation Recommendations

### Priority 1 - Critical Fixes
1. **Safari INP Optimization**
   - Implement requestIdleCallback polyfill
   - Optimize touch event handlers for mobile Safari
   - Add WebKit-specific performance hints

2. **Firefox Memory Management**
   - Implement data virtualization for large datasets
   - Add memory pressure monitoring
   - Optimize font loading strategy

### Priority 2 - Enhancement Opportunities
1. **Progressive Web App Features**
   - Service Worker implementation for offline functionality
   - Web App Manifest for native app experience
   - Background sync for data updates

2. **Advanced Browser APIs**
   - Web Locks API for tab synchronization
   - Broadcast Channel API for cross-tab communication
   - Screen Wake Lock API for presentation mode

### Priority 3 - Future Considerations
1. **Emerging Browser Features**
   - Container Queries for responsive components
   - CSS Cascade Layers for style architecture
   - Import Maps for module loading optimization

2. **Performance Monitoring**
   - Real User Monitoring (RUM) implementation
   - Core Web Vitals tracking by browser
   - Performance regression detection
